stocks.persistence: localStorage.stock, fallback prefers-color-scheme, set on <html> before first paint (frontend/index.html)

paper-under.purpose: Resting index tabs: a shade darker than the top sheet on both stocks, so the active (paper) tab reads as the one in front.

warn.purpose: The warn status pill only; amber ink that holds 4.5:1 on day paper, lifts to the orange highlighter on night stock.

on-desk-3.purpose: Desk-tool lettering at full brightness on hover.

display.purpose: The sheet title under its 2px rule; the login brand. 20px under 720px.

headline.purpose: The question in its box, filling the box; 17px under 720px.

page-title.purpose: Page titles on Setup, History, Manage; the completion title; the modal title (700 caps there).

title.purpose: Values in underlined header fields; list-row primary text.

body.purpose: Reading text. Standalone prose keeps a 52-66ch measure; anything inside a box, a record or a row fills its container.

meta.purpose: Row metadata, the "Your turn" line (13.5px), page meta (12.5px); in ink-2.

hint.purpose: "Ctrl + Enter submits", "scored when the topic closes"; 12px tracked 0.06em in ink-2.

typed.purpose: Only the candidate's words: responses, the reply textarea, model answers (14.5/24), typewriter status (14px), exchange transcripts (14/22), the History model answer (13.5/22).

pen.purpose: Only the interviewer: margin notes at 16px; 15.5px in inline remarks and the agenda; 15px in an exchange turn and the record verdict.

label.purpose: Field labels, section heads (11px), exchange and previous-topic keys, model-answer summary, the brief's row keys (10px); in ink-2.

label-inverted.purpose: 10px caps on the box label (ink fill, paper text) and the status pill (currentColor outline).

control.purpose: Buttons at 0.16em; index tabs 0.14em; quiet and desk buttons 0.1em.

shadows.name: sheet-shadow
shadows.purpose: The sheet and the login cover sheet on the desk.

shadows.name: slip-shadow
shadows.purpose: A slip on the packet: active-job menu, mapping modal.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Textarea, select, reply box focus. Underlined inputs use 0 2px 0 var(--hl).

materials.name: grain
materials.value: SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency 0.8, 2 octaves, 5% alpha, 200px tile (--grain); none on night stock
materials.purpose: Photocopy texture on the sheet, cover sheet, modal slip and the sticky composer.

materials.name: ruling
materials.purpose: 26px typed rulings under Courier Prime text, inside textareas and on a filed response (.box.r .typed).

materials.name: margin-rule
materials.purpose: The sheet's margin rule; content starts at 76px.

materials.name: composer-fade
materials.value: 12px linear-gradient(to top, var(--paper), transparent) above form.composer
materials.purpose: Filed responses scroll under the sticky reply box through a paper fade.

ready-landing.columns: header fields (candidate, role switcher); .box.next (one 21px line + Start a round); .spread

spread.left: .box.brief: 16px lede, 13.5px company line, rows 104px minmax(0, 1fr) with 10px caps keys; must/nice/looks-for each as a run
spread.right: .margin: .tally (11px caps, four 26px cells, 12.5px hint + Manage) and a .note NUDGE per missing doc/repo

cabinet.left: .index: four ink-ruled sections with 11px caps heads and a quiet Add; .entry button rows (14.5px name, 12.5px meta) named by what the file is, never its filename; the open one fills --hl
cabinet.right: .box.pane labelled by kind: .pane-head (provenance + .pane-actions with a 12px consequence), .digest rows 104px minmax(0, 1fr) with 10px caps keys, or .pane-text (typed 13px, 560px max) after Read the full text
cabinet.tablet: one column under 980px; pane head and digest rows stack under 720px

modal.scroll: header and footer pinned, body scrolls (the repo picker scrolls only its list under a fixed filter)

motion.name: stamp
motion.purpose: The scored rating cell landing in highlighter.

motion.name: consider
motion.value: 1.6s ease-in-out infinite on .cells.scoring .cell, delay calc(var(--i) * 110ms); background transparent -> var(--hl) at 9% -> transparent by 28%
motion.purpose: The pen running along the rating row while the score is being decided; ends when the scored cell stamps.

motion.name: armed-pulse
motion.purpose: Armed destructive control; the thinking pen dot (1s); running task dot (1.2s).

motion.name: cursor-blink
motion.purpose: 2px caret at the end of streaming text.

motion.name: stream-in
motion.purpose: A remark or note arriving on the sheet; the composer returning after a page turn.

motion.name: hl-swipe
motion.purpose: The highlighter painted left-to-right across "Your turn" as the reply box opens.

motion.name: draw
motion.value: 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 60ms both, stroke-dashoffset 1 -> 0 (pathLength 1) on .note.stream-in .k svg path
motion.purpose: The pen drawing the margin arrow while a note streams in.

motion.name: view-transition-group
motion.purpose: The paper moving: named parts travel between states (see viewTransitions).

motion.name: vt-route
motion.value: html[data-vt="route"]: old(sheet) vt-out 120ms ease-out; new(sheet) vt-in 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) from opacity 0 translateY(10px)
motion.purpose: Pulling the next sheet from the packet on an index-tab click.

motion.name: typewriter-status
motion.purpose: Status line while the model thinks.

motion.name: closing
motion.value: highlighter swipe across the title at 300ms; .stamp (3px double currentColor, 17px 700 caps .18em + 10px date, rotate -6deg, --stamp-ink mask, multiply/screen) slams at 420ms over 320ms with a 2px jolt; VERDICT pen note rises at 1240ms; all gated on .practice-done.play, still on revisit
motion.purpose: Round completion (COMPLETE in --ok) and abandonment (ABANDONED in --pen, stamp only). Replaced react-confetti 2026-08-28.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { animation-duration: .01ms; iteration-count: 1; transition-duration: .01ms; ::view-transition-* { animation: none } } and viewTransition() applies the update plainly
motion.purpose: Every animation and transition collapses; view transitions are skipped entirely.

viewTransitions.helper: frontend/src/viewTransition.ts - viewTransition(update, kind?): startViewTransition(() => flushSync(update)) where supported and motion is not reduced, else a plain update; kind sits on <html data-vt> for the duration.

names.name: sheet
names.purpose: The sheet swapped on navigation; fades out 120ms, the new one rises 10px in 280ms under data-vt="route".

names.name: active-tab
names.purpose: The ink fill slides from tab to tab on navigation.

names.name: composer
names.purpose: Filing a response: the reply box morphs into the response it becomes.

names.name: question
names.purpose: The question box holds its place between renders; when the page turns it clears and the next question streams into it.

names.name: topic-<index>
names.selector: a closed topic's assessment box and its previous-topics row (InterviewPage.tsx, keyed by thread index)
names.purpose: A closed topic folds into the previous-topics index.

viewTransitions.invariant: Names are unique per snapshot by construction; a duplicate aborts the transition (Chrome logs it), so a console warning is a defect.

favicon.source: frontend/index.html, inline SVG data URI, viewBox 0 0 32 32
favicon.note: Pigments are literal because a favicon cannot read custom properties; they equal the day-stock desk-2, paper, ink and hl tokens.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Scorecard and record body drop to one column; margin note loses tilt; clipboard no longer sticky; sheet padding tightens.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Desk bar stacks; header fields one column; cells 26px; title 20px; question 17px; exchange turns reflow to one column; the brief stacks and the on-file line drops under the Start button.

breakpoints.name: sticky-clipboard
breakpoints.purpose: .sc-margin is position: sticky; top: 24px only on a tall desktop.

icons.sizes: 12-16px (13px inside buttons, 14px desk tools, 12px summary chevrons)

components.name: Packet Cover
components.description: The ready landing: the NEXT box (a boxed field with an inverted label, one 21px line on what a round is, and the Start a round button) over a two-column spread - the Role brief box (16px lede, company line, Must have / Nice to have / Looks for each as a run) and a margin holding the packet tally (11px caps 'PACKET · 3 OF 4', four 26px cells ink-filled with an inset paper ring or dashed when empty, a 12.5px hint with Manage) and the interviewer's red-pen NUDGE for each missing doc or repo with a pen-coloured quiet Add link. narrative.overview:
The app is the document that decides the candidate's fate, being filled in live. Every screen is a photocopied form on a charcoal desk: index tabs cut from the sheet's top edge, a 1px margin rule, two staples, boxed fields with inverted corner labels, a form title under a 2px rule. Three voices share the sheet and never blur: the form speaks in Archivo caps, the candidate speaks in Courier Prime on 26px rulings, and the interviewer speaks in red ballpoint (Archivo condensed to 78% width, tilted -1.2deg in the margin). Yellow highlighter is the only other colour, and it always means "this is what matters right now": whose turn it is, which option is chosen, which cell got the score.

The world is flat and material. Depth exists once, between the desk and the sheet (and again for a slip laid on top of the packet); nothing on the paper itself floats. There are no rounded cards, no tinted panels, no gradients on the sheet. Structure is drawn with rules, boxes and inverted labels, the way a printed form does it. Density is that of a real scorecard: 15px body, 10.5px caps labels, 14px gaps, one sheet per screen - and the sheet takes most of the desk (`min(1600px, 100%)`), so on a 1920px display the paper covers five sixths of the width with a strip of desk either side.

Two paper stocks exist and the reader chooses: day (off-white on charcoal) and night (slate pages, light ink on a near-black desk). The night stock keeps every relationship, only the pigments change; the grain is dropped because dark paper does not photocopy.
keyCharacteristics: Paper sheet on a desk: `--paper` with SVG grain and a two-layer shadow, on a radial charcoal gradient.
Three voices, three faces: Archivo caps (form), Courier Prime (candidate), Archivo wdth 78 red (interviewer).
Zero radius on the sheet; the only curves are the 3px top corners of the index tabs.
Highlighter (`--hl`) is a state, not a decoration: current turn, selection, score.
Red (`--pen`) belongs to the interviewer and to armed destructive controls; nothing else is red.

Motion is the hand at work: typewriter status, pulsing pen dot, blinking caret, the stamp, the highlighter drawn across "Your turn", the pen drawing the margin arrow, the pen running along the rating row while a topic is scored, the round closed with the highlighter across "Round complete.", the panel's stamp and the interviewer's verdict - and the paper moving: the reply box files itself as a response, a closed topic folds into the index, the next sheet is pulled from the packet (view transitions).

rules.name: The Red Is The Interviewer Rule
rules.body: `--pen` is reserved for the interviewer's voice and for the armed state of a destructive control. Errors use it because an error is the interviewer's note too. Never use red for emphasis, links, or decoration; a resting destructive control is ink, and turns red only once armed.

rules.name: The Highlighter Is A State Rule
rules.body: `--hl` fills exactly the thing that is live: the current turn, the chosen option, the scored cell, the focused field's ring. It never fills a button, a card, or a heading.

rules.name: The Two-Stock Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a custom property on `:root` and remapped on `:root[data-theme="dark"]`. No component may hard-code a pigment; the stock is set before first paint from `localStorage.stock` (fallback `prefers-color-scheme`) and toggled by the desk button. Exceptions that exist in the build: `#fff` on pen-filled controls, the staple greys, and the modal backdrop.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime is only ever the candidate's words (and the model answer as a would-be transcript). Red condensed Archivo is only ever the interviewer. Everything else is the form and is set in Archivo at normal width. A voice never borrows another's face.

rules.name: The Caps Label Rule
rules.body: Every label is 9.5-11px Archivo 700, uppercase, tracked 0.12-0.16em, in `--ink-2` (or inverted on ink). Labels sit above or in the top-left corner of the thing they name. They are never placed above a heading as a kicker.

rules.name: The Paper Is Flat Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the sheet casts a shadow. If an element needs to stand out, box it in 1px ink, give it an inverted label, or highlight it. Shadows exist only for paper on the desk and slips on the paper.

dos: Do put every screen on one sheet: `--paper` with `--grain`, `--sheet-shadow`, the 60px margin rule and two staples, tabs cut from the top edge.
Do draw structure with ink rules and boxes (1px box, 2px title rule, 1.5px button outline) and name things with 10px caps labels or inverted corner labels.
Do set the candidate's words in Courier Prime 15.5px on 26px `--rule` rulings, and the interviewer's in `--pen` Archivo at 78% width.
Do use `--hl` for the live thing only: current turn, chosen option, scored cell, focus ring.
Do keep destructive controls ink at rest and morph them to `--pen` with a pulse only when armed.
Do define any new colour on both stocks (`:root` and `:root[data-theme="dark"]`) and pair `--hl` with `--hl-ink`.
Do render icons from lucide at 12-16px (13px inside buttons, 14px in desk tools), stroke 1.8, in currentColor.

Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion`; motion is limited to the stamp, the scoring sweep, the pen dot, the caret, the 220ms stream-in, the highlighter swipe, the arrow draw, the view transitions listed under Motion, and the round's closing (highlighter, stamp, verdict). Reduced motion skips the view transitions entirely and collapses the rest.
Do keep the reply box and the interviewer's clipboard sticky on desktop; whose move it is must survive a long transcript.
donts: Don't round corners on the sheet. The only radius is `3px 3px 0 0` on index tabs and `3px` on desk buttons.
Don't cast shadows on the paper. Shadows belong to the sheet on the desk and slips on the sheet.
Don't use `--pen` for emphasis, links, headings or decoration; red is the interviewer and the armed state.
Don't fill buttons, cards or headings with highlighter, and don't tint panels with any colour but `--paper-2` on hover.
Don't set anything but the candidate's words (and the model answer) in Courier Prime, and don't use a serif, an italic display, or a system UI face.
Don't place a caps label above a heading as a kicker or eyebrow; labels name a field or a section and sit on the thing they name (the modal's meta line sits under its title).
Don't hard-code a pigment in a component; the stock toggle must remap it.
Don't fetch fonts or assets from outside the box; faces are self-hosted woff2 under `/fonts/`.
